note: GLOBAL-I18N-04 — per-key provenance for the fr catalogue in this directory. `machine` = produced by scripts/i18n-translate.mjs and NOT yet read by a human. `reviewed` = a human signed off; the pipeline never overwrites it. `stale` = the Persian source changed after a human review — the fr text on disk is the last reviewed one and needs a human, not a re-run.
